hook: Three gold prices. All can be right.

editorial_brief.viewer_question: Why does the global chart, MCX screen and jeweller show different gold prices?
editorial_brief.misconception: There is one universal gold price that every screen should match.
editorial_brief.mechanism: Global gold is a dollar benchmark, MCX is an Indian futures contract, and a jeweller quote is a retail price with local components.
editorial_brief.proof_plan: Use dated global benchmark, MCX contract and retail-quote labels in the companion carousel; no live figures appear in this Reel.
editorial_brief.boundary: This does not establish a fair retail price or predict the next market move.
editorial_brief.memory_check: Before comparing gold prices, ask which gold price you are seeing.
editorial_brief.human_opening: Someone checking a jeweller quote after seeing a different gold price on their phone.
editorial_brief.primary_source: MCX Gold contract specification, LBMA/World Gold Council reference material, and dated retail quote documentation for the companion carousel.
editorial_brief.save_frame: Before comparing gold prices: name the reference — global, MCX, or retail.
editorial_brief.voice_tone: Warm and matter-of-fact, like a financially literate friend clearing up a family purchase conversation.

storyboard.visual: Gold bangle and globe introduce the competing references.
storyboard.copy: 3 GOLD PRICES. ALL CAN BE RIGHT.

storyboard.visual: The globe becomes the global benchmark.
A futures contract and gold bar establish the Indian exchange reference.
storyboard.copy:
2  MCX GOLD
A RUPEE FUTURES CONTRACT

storyboard.visual: A gold bangle becomes the retail reference.
All three references settle into one clear comparison.
storyboard.copy: ASK: WHICH GOLD PRICE AM I SEEING?

voiceover: Your gold chart, MCX screen and jeweller can show different prices—and all be right. Global gold is a dollar benchmark. MCX is an Indian futures contract. A jeweller quote includes purity and retail costs. Before comparing gold prices, ask: which gold price am I seeing?
caption:
The global gold chart, MCX Gold and a jeweller’s quote answer different questions. One is a global dollar benchmark, one is an Indian futures contract, and one is a retail price. Before comparing gold prices, identify the reference first.

Educational data, not investment advice.
